supported.question_normalization: Trim outer whitespace; replace line breaks with spaces for native plain-text context. No use in card selection.
reading: JSON export with full native replay
presentation: React DOM UI in modular screens/components

supported.persistence: In-memory visit only; explicit JSON download; no account, database, localStorage or analytics

rendering.pixel_allocation: Displayed-size bounded DPR; adaptive sustained-miss reductions
rendering.measurement: Renderer callback intervals separate from RAF; explicit host/driver/emulation conditions

experimental.gemini: Server-side, separately opt-in per reading; signed native request recomputed; exact card/rule references and bounded output shape checked; semantic faithfulness is not guaranteed. Native output never replaced.
experimental.performance: Local Chromium mobile emulation measurements only; no real-device CWV, INP or GPU certification

art_rights.pack: User supplied Downloads/FATE-asset-pack-01.zip; original procedural artwork and synthesized audio per included README
art_rights.cards: Historical Pamela Colman Smith Pam-A illustrations, 1910; all 78 per-file public-domain records pinned in artwork-sources.json; no modern recoloring or mixed replacement
art_rights.fonts: Self-hosted Cormorant Garamond and Inter; SIL OFL licenses and source URLs bundled
art_rights.generated: Original back and nebula made with built-in image_gen; prompts and source PNGs retained under design/. Poster extracted from actual renderer.

scope: Consumer visual foundation over the unchanged supported symbolic engine; no new technique, factual forecast or predictive certification
